deploymentState: The VN LMV IT Flow remains deployed OFF and unchanged by this offline source update.
name: os_sr_avchk

actions.operation: Trigger on a new Pending os_sr_avq row
Read the created request and required inputs only
Read the referenced TA and, for Onsite only, Location
Validate active references, permitted normalized addresses, mode, window and duration; fail closed before the provider call if invalid
Retain only the validated reference snapshots in Flow memory
Call Office 365 Outlook Find meeting times (V2) using the exact provider inputs below
Validate the entire provider response and required attendee structure; unknown or malformed shapes fail closed
Capture current UTC after the provider call, then filter and normalize suggestions using OutlookMeetingTimesAdapter and AvailabilityRules as the offline reference contract
Before every terminal write, re-read TA and, for Onsite only, Location
Apply ReferenceDriftPolicy.BeforeTerminalWrite to the memory-only snapshots; relevant drift or failed re-read overrides the proposed result with Failed, slots [], and REFERENCE_CHANGED
Write exactly one terminal Available, NoSlots or Failed result using only state, reason, error, canonical slots, queried-at and expiry

inputs.RequiredAttendees: Normalized TA email from the validated snapshot
inputs.ResourceAttendees: Empty for Online; normalized room email from the validated Location snapshot for Onsite

provider.evaluationClock: Capture current UTC after the provider call. Use that same instant as queried-at and for lead-time filtering; never backdate it to the request or call start.

response.acceptedAvailability: Exactly free for each required attendee; each expected address must appear exactly once with the expected required/resource type.
response.organizer: IsOrganizerOptional is true. organizerAvailability is never used to decide whether a slot is usable.
response.unknownOrMalformed: Failed with PROVIDER_RESPONSE_INVALID, slots []; unsupported timezone uses PROVIDER_TIMEZONE_UNSUPPORTED.
response.persistence: Only sorted, distinct UTC startUtc/endUtc slots, subject to count and JSON-length limits. Never persist or expose provider output, reasons, addresses, availability, locations, confidence, organizer or connector error bodies.

provider.implementation: The C# adapter is an offline reference implementation and tests, not an invocable Power Automate action and not itself a deployed Flow. The separate solution-aware Power Automate Flow is deployed OFF in DEV; local hardening source changes still require separate review and deployment.

providerTimezoneFirstRuntimeGate.acceptedRepresentation: timeZone exactly UTC, with an explicitly supported UTC dateTime representation; no timezone input is sent to the action.
providerTimezoneFirstRuntimeGate.trigger: The first synthetic live execution returns a different valid timezone representation.
providerTimezoneFirstRuntimeGate.capture: Capture the actual field names, types and timezone representation in sanitized synthetic evidence only; do not persist raw output, mailbox addresses, connector diagnostics or personal data.
providerTimezoneFirstRuntimeGate.nextAction: Make a separately reviewed bounded adapter correction before any new execution; do not infer timezone semantics.

referenceDrift.normalization: Trim and lowercase invariant; use these exact normalized addresses for the provider call and comparison.
referenceDrift.storage: Memory only. No mailbox snapshot, raw provider data or display-name snapshot is written to the business row. Local source applies action-level secure inputs/outputs to every sensitive path; run-history suppression remains runtime-verification-required.
referenceDrift.recovery: No automatic replacement query or retry after drift; user may initiate a new query.
referenceDrift.boundary: The re-read is immediately before the terminal write, not a distributed lock or a booking guarantee.

runHistoryPrivacy.rule: Secure each action that receives, generates, copies, evaluates, loops over or persists reference snapshots, provider responses, attendee observations or availability slots. Parent protection is not treated as protection for children.
runHistoryPrivacy.platformEvidence: Microsoft Power Automate guidance documents secure inputs and outputs as action settings but does not establish offline that every action type used here persists those settings through solution import and run history.
runHistoryPrivacy.runtimeGate: Before activation, verify the actual OFF definition retains every required setting. Only after separately approved bounded synthetic activation, with a stop and OFF-restoration plan, inspect actual executed trigger, SetVariable, Scope, If, Foreach, Query, Compose, ParseJson and connector paths. Stop further requests on visible sensitive data or dropped settings. Unexecuted paths remain unverified; offline fixtures do not prove suppression.

retry.429: Current implementation: no automatic retry. inputs.retryPolicy type none maps 429 to PROVIDER_THROTTLED. This does not resolve the earlier bounded Retry-After proposal.
retry.proposed429Requirement: Honor Retry-After with at most two retries for this idempotent read, and only while inside an overall request deadline.
retry.ambiguousTimeout: No blind repeat. Complete the row as Failed with PROVIDER_TIMEOUT if no safe response is available.
retry.401_403_404: Fail closed as PROVIDER_AUTH, PROVIDER_PERMISSION or MAILBOX_NOT_FOUND; no retry.
retry.unsupportedTimezoneOrShape: Fail closed; stop the first synthetic live execution and do not retry or broaden conversion.

forbiddenOperations: Candidate Status History create or update

identity.resultWriter: Current DEV owner identity used by the Dataverse Flow connection
identity.outlookConnection: Current DEV owner identity; not an impersonation of the BSO

sourceValidation.pending: Read_query must match the triggering row id and still be Pending; otherwise cancel without a write.
sourceValidation.request: Validate required GUID references, mode, integer duration and explicit-Z UTC timestamps before reference connectors; validate business-hour and provider JSON schemas with fail-closed error mapping.
sourceValidation.provider: Validate the entire Outlook V2 body including optional fields and reject unknown properties. For UTC suggestions accept ISO local-UTC dateTime with optional trailing Z and at most seven fractional digits; reject offsets instead of relabelling them.
sourceValidation.attendees: Absent or duplicate expected TA/room entries are not free. Never evaluate first() on an empty attendee array.
sourceValidation.references: Initial reference response ids must match the request lookups; final id/state/normalized-email re-read still overrides all provider results on drift.
sourceValidation.retryPolicy: inputs.retryPolicy type none is the executable WDL retry setting on every connector action, including terminal persistence; no root-level retryPolicy is relied upon.
sourceValidation.validationBoundary: Local WDL evaluation is not Power Automate or Outlook runtime acceptance. Historical privacy-only preservation is checked against its pinned Git source; the current functional delta has separate boundary, behavior and full-path fixture tests.
